Name: Pine Village Expansion
Author: xJxckie
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

To install Pine Village please follow these key instructions.

[list]
[*]Ensure you have the newest Stardew Version (1.6)
[/list][list]
[*]Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and its latest update.
[/list][list]
[*]Download and set up [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patch[/url]er
[/list][list]
[*]Download and set up [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url]﻿
[/list][list]
[*]Download the mod & unzip the file
[/list][list]
[*]Place the file in StardewValley/Mods
[/list]﻿

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]

﻿Pine Village: Expansion adds a new town to the Valley!
It features 10 new NPCs, 4 are datable, 26 new locations, new shops, stories and adventures too! 
To access Pine Village head to the bus stop or railway station (It will always work to Pine Village, The vault bundle only unlocks Calico Desert)

Click the ticket machine next to the bus and choose Pine Village! Hop on and head to Pine Village!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

Pine Village should be compatable with every mod. There are no known conflicts.
If there are please drop a post.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]

[size=4][b]CREDITS
[/b][/size]This mod was made by xJ_ackie to provide you with a new world to explore.

However it does use certain assets and mods to power it.
